info.title: Meridian HR API
info.description: The Meridian demo vertical (employees, leave, time, expenses, payroll, employment contracts, onboarding) on the Substrat kernel. Every operation checks a permission for the calling principal; a 403 here is the permission system working, not a bug.

post.summary: Create an employee record.
post.description: Requires `employee:manage`. PII (national id) stays in the record — it is never emitted on the event spine.

post.summary: List all employees, including PII fields.
post.description: Requires `employee:manage` (HR admin). Managers use `hr/roster` instead.

post.summary: The roster — employment facts only, no national id, no compensation.
post.description: Requires `absence:read` held at the node (managers, HR). An employee’s own-record grant does not enumerate the team.

post.summary: The caller’s own role hint and linked employee id.
post.description: No permission gate: reveals only the caller’s own facts. The kernel still enforces the real permission on every operation regardless of this hint.

post.summary: Define (or redefine) a leave type.
post.description: Requires `absence:configure`.

post.summary: List leave types.
post.description: Requires `absence:read` — at the node, or via the caller’s own-record grant when `employeeId` names their own record.

post.summary: Grant an accrual to an employee’s absence ledger.
post.description: Requires `absence:configure`. The ledger is append-only: an accrual is a new row, never an edit.

post.summary: One employee’s balance per leave type (a fold of the ledger).
post.description: Requires `absence:read` for the named employee — node holders pass for anyone, employees only for themselves.

post.summary: Request time off.
post.description: Requires `absence:request` for the named employee (self-service via the own-record grant).

post.summary: Approve or reject a leave request.
post.description: Requires `absence:approve`. Only a `requested` leave can be decided; approval books the ledger and cannot overdraw the balance.

post.summary: List leave requests, optionally by status.
post.description: Requires `absence:read` at the node.

post.summary: One employee’s own leave requests (the self-service path).
post.description: Requires `absence:read` for the named employee.

post.summary: Create a project for time to book against.
post.description: Requires `project:manage`.

post.summary: The project catalogue.
post.description: Requires `time:read` — at the node, or via the caller’s own-record grant when `employeeId` names their own record.

post.summary: Log worked hours (append-only).
post.description: Requires `time:report` for the named employee.

post.summary: One employee’s time entries and total.
post.description: Requires `time:read` for the named employee.

post.summary: Submit an expense.
post.description: Requires `expense:submit` for the named employee.

post.summary: Approve or reject a submitted expense.
post.description: Requires `expense:approve`. Only a `submitted` expense can be decided.

post.summary: List expenses, optionally by status.
post.description: Requires `expense:read` at the node.

post.summary: One employee’s own expenses (the self-service path).
post.description: Requires `expense:read` for the named employee.

post.summary: The variable-pay export: approved expenses + booked absence in the window.
post.description: Requires `payroll:export`. Exported expenses are marked so a re-run never double-counts.

post.summary: Set an employee’s employment terms (append-only; latest wins).
post.description: Requires `employee:manage`. A signed contract pins the hash of the terms row current when it was issued.

post.summary: The latest employment terms for one employee.
post.description: Requires `employee:manage`.

post.summary: Issue the employment contract for signature (instantiate, bind, dispatch — one transaction).
post.description: Requires `employee:manage` plus the protocol engine’s create/bind/request-signature permissions.

post.summary: Re-derive the terms hash and compare it to what the protocol froze.
post.description: Requires protocol read on the instance. `matches: false` means the terms row moved after issue — a finding, not an invalid signature.

post.summary: Start an onboarding checklist for an employee (protocol engine, composed).
post.description: Requires the protocol engine’s create permission.

post.summary: The event-spine timeline for one entity.
post.description: Requires `absence:read` for the entity.

ValidationFailed.description: Validation failed — the input did not parse against the operation schema. Carries `code`: `validation_failed`.

Unauthenticated.description: No session — sign in (or present a bearer token) first. Carries `code`: `unauthenticated`.

Forbidden.description: Refused — the caller lacks the permission this operation checks, or policy forbids it. Carries `code`: `permission_denied` or `forbidden`.

NotFound.description: Unknown operation, or an entity named in the input does not exist. Carries `code`: `not_found`.

Conflict.description: Conflicts with current state — an illegal transition, a name already taken, or a record that is immutable now. Carries `code`: `conflict`.

InternalError.description: Internal error. The body carries no `detail`, deliberately — an unreviewed message is not disclosed on a multi-tenant surface. Carries `code`: `internal`.

Unavailable.description: The deployment cannot serve this — a required platform facility is unconfigured. Carries `code`: `unavailable`.

session.name: sb_session
session.description: The vertical's session cookie. Instances on the Better-Auth provider use its cookie instead; same-origin requests carry either automatically.
